description: Get daily net ETF flow history for a single crypto asset over the last 30 days. Returns a time series of net USD millions per day (positive = inflow, negative = outflow). Figures are asset-level totals with no per-fund breakdown; per-fund tables (IBIT, FBTC, ETHA and others) are published at https://cryptoetf.today/en/<slug>-etf-flows, slug = bitcoin, ethereum, solana, xrp, hype, dogecoin, chainlink, avalanche, hedera, litecoin, bnb, polkadot, sui, near, tron or zcash.

asset.description: Asset to fetch: btc, eth, sol, xrp, hyp, doge, link, avax, hbar, ltc, bnb, dot, sui, near, trx, zec

name: get_asset_flows
title: Crypto ETF Flow History
